$note: First receive-only dossier — stresses the schema from the no-TX end (txPowerBands empty, whole sections tbd). Unit: the RTL-SDR Blog V4 on the Pi5 (10.0.0.128), driven by the gate's SoapySDR adapter.

identity.$source: the physical V4 dongle on the Pi5; gate soapy-adapter sessions 2026-08

driver.$note: V4 needs the RTL-SDR Blog fork of librtlsdr — the stock Osmocom driver mis-tunes the V4's R828D arrangement.

canTransmit.$note: Receive-only hardware; there is no TX section in this dossier at all — an absent facet is the honest shape, not an empty one.

tuningRanges.$note: Continuous 500 kHz - 1.766 GHz: the V4's built-in always-on upconverter covers HF natively (no V3-style direct-sampling mode switch).

capabilities.$txPowerBands_note: Empty ON PURPOSE: rx-only. A consumer must render no TX affordance whatsoever.

sampleRatesHz.$note: 2.4 Msps is the max reliable rate; 3.2 Msps exists but drops samples. 8-bit samples throughout.

gain_ladder.$note: R828D gain steps not yet enumerated from this unit — the soapy adapter reports gain state (recent gate work) but the ladder hasn't been captured into data. First evidence-upgrade candidate.

ppm_correction.$note: This unit's frequency error not yet measured (WWV method as used on the Radioberry would do it).

modes.$source: gate soapy adapter — demodulation is entirely host-side
modes.$native_note: The hardware demodulates nothing: it ships raw IQ and every mode is the consumer's DSP. An empty native list with host-side demod is the correct receive-only-SDR shape (same class as AE's HL2 backend owning an engine-side WDSP chain).

meters.$note: No calibrated signal metering; RSSI from the tuner is uncalibrated. tbd until someone characterises it.

scope.$source: gate soapy adapter span work (current_span_hz fix)

points.$note: Like the Flex, no per-model frame constant — the host computes the FFT; span is bounded by the tuned sample rate.

rx.format: demodulated by the consumer from raw IQ

hf_via_builtin_upconverter.$note: V4-specific: HF arrives through the always-on upconverter, so no direct-sampling mode switch and no V3-style Q-branch quirks. Spurs profile differs from V3.

x-gate.$note: Gate presentation & deployment for this unit.

host.$note: Same Pi as the 9700 gate; a second gate instance needs its own port set.

service_unit.$note: No systemd unit yet — launcher/hand-started. Making aether-gate-rtl a proper unit is a known small bite.
